description.value: The Great Exhibition Road Festival is a free annual celebration of science and the arts each summer in South Kensington. Join us on 6-7 June 2026 from 12.00-18.00 each day for a weekend of free science and arts events for all ages. Enjoy hands-on workshops, fascinating talks, performances and installations from iconic museums, research and culture organisations, including Imperial College London, the Natural History Museum, Science Museum, the Royal Parks, V&A and many more. Whether you’re exploring the stars through the medium of Bollywood dance, building a squishy textile robot or traversing the surface of Mars by tasting chocolate brownies, there’s something for everyone at the Great Exhibition Road Festival!

The Great Exhibition Road Festival is a free annual celebration of science and the arts each summer in South Kensington. Join us on 6-7 June 2026 from 12.00-18.00 each day for a weekend of free science and arts events for all ages.
Enjoy hands-on workshops, fascinating talks, performances and installations from iconic museums, research and culture organisations, including Imperial College London, the Natural History Museum, Science Museum, the Royal Parks, V&A and many more.
Whether you’re exploring the stars through the medium of Bollywood dance, building a squishy textile robot or traversing the surface of Mars by tasting chocolate brownies, there’s something for everyone at the Great Exhibition Road Festival!
